description: Embrasure helps ChatGPT and Codex investigate silent data failures without querying arbitrary warehouse rows. Inspect table health and Scout evidence, trace table- and column-level lineage, identify downstream services and owners, and understand blast radius before a change. Reads respect workspace permissions. Scout changes always require preview and explicit approval.

defaultPrompt: What production tables look unhealthy right now? Prioritize silent failures by blast radius.
Investigate what changed in analytics.orders, trace the root cause, and show downstream impact.
What will break if I change analytics.customers.customer_id? Show the column-level lineage and owners.
